about: The cast iron dutch oven as the skeleton holds it, first and third person (Cooking V1 K1a, docs/gameplay/cooking_v1_plan.md 7). Points, bounds: item block units of the pot mesh as client/AflStaticMeshItemClient draws it (meshes/cast_iron_dutch_oven.aflmesh.json + (0.5, 0.011204, 0.5), 1 px = 1 cm, an item unit 16 cm; tools/build-equipment-meshes-v1.mjs OVEN). Scale 0.24: 1.5 x real size (the held size rule of 2026-10-27), 58 cm over the handles. handle_e / handle_w: the outer bar of each cast loop handle (x +- 18.6 cm, 8.7 cm up), where the hands hold it; center: the middle of the pot.
